{"metadata":{"description":"Results-only toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process, keeps one live status line while the agent works, with a per-turn trace line and a settings row. zh-CN/en.","id":"gh:1335317660","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-result-only-view","slug":"YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","productivity","web-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Results-only toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process, keeps on"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e live status line while the agent works, with a per-turn trace line and a settings row. zh-CN/en."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-result-only-view"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A **Results only** toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. Turn it on and thinking, tool-call and c"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ontext-injection rows fold away — only your messages and the final replies remain. Open any of them "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"again whenever you want the details."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Default on; the state persists in `localStorage`.
- **While the agent runs** — one compact chip pe"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"r running step (tool name + args hint, or the latest thinking line). Click a chip to reveal and expa"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nd that step's native row mid-run. With no active step, a single live status line shows the latest o"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ne.
- **After a turn settles** — a `Processed N steps · Xs ▸` trace appears at the turn tail: click "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"to expand that turn's process rows; click again to fold them back. Moving the mouse across the line "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"does nothing — expansion is strictly click-driven.
- **Fold modes** — Auto folds settled turns for y"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ou; Manual keeps them visible until you fold them from the trace line.
- **Never hidden** — whitelis"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ted interactive cards (`ask_user_question`, `cordis_run`) and composer approval prompts stay visible"},{"id":"p6s9","text":".
- Settings → General → Results only: show/hide the trace, restore animations under reduced motion,"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" pick the fold mode. zh-CN/en localized."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web`. Reads/writes `localSt"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"orage` and reads the conversation DOM read-only — the product DOM is never modified.
- Hiding relies"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" on stable product DOM attributes plus a MutationObserver for chips. If a DSH update changes the att"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ributes, the plugin degrades gracefully (rows stop hiding) — please report DSH + plugin versions in "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"an issue.
- Row-level CSS fallbacks cover browsers without `:has()`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 简体中文"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness Web 的「只看结果」开关。开启后思考行、工具调用行与上下文注入行全部折叠——对话里只剩你的消息和最终回复；需要细节时随时点开。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- 默认开启，状态保存在 `localStorage`。

- **折叠方式**：自动——回合结束后自动折叠过程行；手动——保留过程行，由你点击痕迹行折叠。

- 设置 → 常规 → 只看结果：开关痕迹行、减少动态效果下恢复动画、选择折叠方式。中英双语。"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 安装"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"然后重启 `dsh web`。卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-result-only-view` 再重启。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 说明"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- 纯客户端：无网络请求、不访问文件系统、不接触凭据；仅读写 `localStorage` 并只读对话 DOM，不改产品 DOM 结构。
- 隐藏依赖稳定的产品 DOM 属性并用 MutationOb"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"server 渲染芯片；若产品升级改动属性会优雅降级（停止隐藏），请在 issue 中附上双方版本。
